name: io.github.Abhishekkumar2021/http
title: HTTP
description: HTTP/REST client with saved collections, env secrets, and SSRF-safe host allowlisting.

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_ALLOW_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed hosts (exact or *.example.com). Required — the server refuses to start without it.

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_WRITABLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to allow mutating methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE).
